name: Derya Karadaş
bio:
Derya Karadaş (born 4 May 1981) is a Turkish actress. Her family, who lived in Bingöl until they moved to Istanbul in 1980, are of Kurdish and Alevi origin.

She rose to prominence with her role as Zerrin in Yalan Dünya. She studied at the Müjdat Gezen Art Center conservatory and is an instructor at the same institute.
